faq.a1: Pick how you feel, what you want from the movie and the era you prefer: Mood-E combines these choices and queries the TMDB database to suggest up to 15 movies matching your mood. With "New picks" you get more titles with the same filters.
faq.a10: The subscription is handled by your Apple ID: go to iOS Settings > your name > Subscriptions to change or cancel it anytime. On a new iPhone just tap "Restore purchases" in Mood-E's Settings to reactivate Premium without paying again.
faq.a11: With Premium, your mood diary, watchlist, planned movies, memories and completed challenges sync automatically across your Apple devices through your private iCloud. Only you can access this data — Mood-E cannot read it. Your device needs to be signed into iCloud.
faq.a12: Pick the platforms you subscribe to in Settings > My streaming services (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+...): a green badge will appear on posters when the movie is included in one of your subscriptions. Your selection stays on your device only.
faq.a13: You and another person each pick your own mood and goal: Mood-E combines both selections and suggests movies perfect for both of you. Just share a 6-digit code, no account needed — the code expires automatically after a few hours. It's a Premium feature.
faq.a14: From Settings > Invite friends, share your friend code or invite link. Once linked, you'll see each other's watching stats (movies watched, minutes, day streaks): who watches more? Only aggregate stats are shared — never movie titles or your diary.
faq.a15: No, the app works fully without an account. If you want, you can sign in with Apple or Google to enable cloud backup of your diary, watchlist and planned movies, so you get them back on a new iPhone. You can sign out or delete the account and all data anytime from Settings.
faq.a16: Yes, with Premium you can ask Siri to suggest a movie or log your mood without opening the app. Find the full list of available commands in Settings > Siri Commands.
faq.a2: No. When you mark a movie as "Seen it", it's automatically excluded from Home recommendations and Trending. You can review your watched movies in the "My List" tab.
faq.a3: Everything stays on your iPhone: the watchlist and watched movies are saved locally only. No account is needed and no data is sent to external servers.
faq.a4: Go to Settings and turn on "New releases and movies in theatres". You'll get an alert when new movies arrive on TMDB and on the day a movie hits theatres. You can turn them off anytime with the same switch.
faq.a5: Your location is only used to show movies playing in your country and cinemas near you via Apple Maps. You can decline with "Not now": in that case the country set on your iPhone is used.
faq.a6: No, trailers always play inside Mood-E in a dedicated window, without ever leaving the app.
faq.a7: Titles, posters, ratings and trailers are provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). This app uses TMDB data but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
faq.a8: From the "Support" section in Settings tap "Report a problem": the GitHub page will open where you can describe the issue or request a new feature. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
faq.a9: Premium is an optional monthly subscription that removes all ads and unlocks: Duo Night, Challenge a Friend, iCloud sync across your devices, exclusive icons and themes, movie quizzes, Siri commands and the custom profile with name, avatar and photo. All core features stay free forever.

settings.legal.footer: This app uses data provided by TMDB but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Legal documents are currently available in Italian.
settings.list.footer: Movies marked as "watched" are removed automatically after a week. Once removed, they may reappear among recommendations. You can always remove them manually from the list.
settings.notif.alert.msg: To receive alerts about new releases, allow Mood-E notifications in iOS settings.
settings.notif.alert.title: Notifications disabled
settings.notif.footer: Get an alert when new movies arrive on TMDB and on the day a movie hits theatres. You can turn them off anytime.
settings.notif.footer2: An evening check-in reminder, a gentle nudge about movies saved more than 5 days ago, and new releases matching your recent moods. Each alert can be switched off individually.
settings.notif.toggle: New releases and movies in theatres
settings.perso.footer: Unlock alternate icons and color themes by reaching milestones in the app.
settings.services.footer: Pick the services you subscribe to: included movies show the "Available now" badge on their poster.
settings.siri.footer: Ask Siri for a movie that fits your mood, without opening the app.
settings.support.footer: To report a problem or request a new feature, open a request on our GitHub. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
settings.title: Settings
siri.intro: You can ask Siri what to watch tonight: it will ask how you feel and open Mood-E straight on a ready proposal, skipping every step.
siri.note: From the Shortcuts app you can also record a custom phrase, for example “What do I watch tonight”.
siri.step1: Activate Siri: hold the side button or say “Hey Siri”.
siri.step2: Say the command phrase, for example “What should I watch on Mood-E”.
siri.step3: Siri asks how you feel and opens Mood-E with a proposal ready.
